mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about the martyrs of the Quit India Movement: 1. Kanaklata Barua was 17 years old. 2. Matangini Hazra was shot while leading a flag procession. 3. Kanaklata Barua and Matangini Hazra were both associated with Tamluk in Bengal. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcq_fix.why: Kanaklata Barua (b. Dec 1924, shot Sept 1942) was 17, not 15

o: Father of the Nation — Subhas Chandra Bose
Netaji — Subhas Chandra Bose, as given by the people of Germany
Ittefaq, Itmad, Qurbani — Indian National Congress
mcq_fix.why: Gandhi called Bose 'Patriot of patriots', so option 1 was also correct

patterns: APPSC asks single facts: Tripuri opponent (Pattabhi), Andhra Forward Bloc member (Madduri Annapurnaiah), where Azad Hind Fauj was started (Singapore), Azad Hind Radio (Germany), Dilli Chalo, Bose initiating planning (NPC 1938).
Red Fort trial items recur everywhere: accused trio Shah Nawaz-Sehgal-Dhillon, defence led by Bhulabhai Desai, 'who was NOT in the dock' (Rash Behari Bose).

Other PSCs repeat: Forward Bloc 1939, political guru C.R. Das, Rani Jhansi Regiment, first INA commander Mohan Singh, IIL by Rash Behari Bose, 21 Oct 1943, recognised by 9 countries, Nicobar = Swaraj.
Slogan traps: Do or Die = Gandhi, Quit India coined by Yusuf Meherally, Father of the Nation first used by Bose.
App MCQs match PYQ depth well; they add Quit India / August Offer context and AP Forward Bloc detail.
